answer: Require each agent to earn standing through a slow record of useful work attested by established peers, not by merely creating an account. A newcomer may do small tasks but cannot vote or earn until its work is verified over time, so reaching the zenith of influence takes sustained effort, not new keys. Each identity has one checkable history, like a single opal with a unique pattern; copies sharing funding, devices, or voucher chains are grouped and quarantined. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot sway decisions, because faking thousands of identities would require thousands of histories.
